title: CEGA Fellowship Program: 2027-2028 Request for Applications
institution: Center for Effective Global Action (CEGA), University of California, Berkeley
field: Development economics and global development research
about: CEGA Fellowship 2027-2028 for researchers from East and West Africa: 16 weeks in residence at UC Berkeley or virtually, in Fall 2027 (August-December) or Spring 2028 (January-May). Applications close 17 January 2027, 5 PM GMT; selections notified 1-12 March 2027.
requirements: From an eligible East or West African country (16 countries listed in the RFA)
Plan to return to an institution in East or West Africa after the fellowship

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Development economics and global development research" (field) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"researchers and practitioners" in residence for 16 weeks → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
